header: I use this to read ONE stored page once with Gemini and print what the service says about it: how long it took, how the answer ended, the tokens spent on the page, the answer and "thinking", and whether the answer repeats itself. It writes NOTHING (no database write, no file). Use it to find out why a page's read is slow or never comes back; see src/lib/ingestion/geminiProbe.ts. npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/gemini-probe.ts --id 85 --page 2 --timeout 300 --id N --page P the circular and its page (1-based), read from the database and the page image's address --file path.png or a page image on disk instead --timeout S seconds to wait for the answer (default 300) --max-tokens N the answer's length limit (default 8192, what the upload sends) --thinking-budget N tokens the model may spend thinking (0 = none); left out unless given --jpeg-edge N send the page shrunk: a JPEG whose long side is N pixels (default 2400 when a --jpeg option is used) --jpeg-quality Q the JPEG quality, 1 to 100 (default 85) --compare read the page TWICE, as stored (A) and shrunk (B), and compare time, size and numbers: one command to learn whether the size matters --base-url URL another address of the service (for tests) You need GEMINI_API_KEY (GEMINI_VISION_MODEL names the model) and, with --id, DATABASE_URL.
